attchmntText: Superhouse Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Superhouse Limited announced that its Board of Directors approved the Standalone and Consolidated Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended 30th September, 2026, on 14th November, 2026. The Board Meeting commenced at 2.00 P.M. and concluded at 2.45 P.M. Standalone revenue from operations for the half year was Rs. 27,421.29 Lacs, with a profit before tax of Rs. 1,540.85 Lacs. Standalone net profit after tax for the half year was Rs. 556.05 Lacs. Consolidated revenue from operations for the half year was Rs. 34,994.91 Lacs, with a profit before tax of Rs. 1,411.01 Lacs. Consolidated net profit after tax for the half year was Rs. 724.51 Lacs. The results were reviewed by the Audit Committee and subjected to a limited review by statutory auditors.
